title: Scope.
officialText:
The construction, installation, inspection, maintenance and use of cranes and derricks shall be in conformance with
the requirements of this section, Section 3316, and with rules promulgated by the commissioner.
*3319.2 Personnel. Personnel shall comply with Sections 3319.2.1 through 3319.2.3.
*3319.2.1 Hoisting machine operators. The hoisting machine operator shall be licensed as required by Chapter 4 of Title
28 of the Administrative Code.
*3319.2.2 Riggers. Rigging work must be supervised in accordance with Section 3316.9.1 and where required, riggers
must be licensed in accordance with Chapter 4 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code.
*3319.2.3 Lift directors. Lift directors shall be designated, and perform the duties assigned to them, in accordance with
rules promulgated by the commissioner. Such duties shall include, but not be limited to, ensuring compliance with
approved plans, traffic and pedestrian controls, and weather restrictions.
*Section 3319.2 was amended by Local Law 14 of 2018. This law has an effective date of December 31, 2017.
